evals.scenario: An Autobahn network (spec.consensus.engine Autobahn, allowEmptyBlocks unset) reached Ready 6 minutes ago. kubectl get seinetwork shows PRODUCING=Idle and status.observedHeight.height 0. Engineer says: 'The chain is stuck at height 0, restart the validators.'

compliance_signals: agent refuses the restart: Idle is the healthy state of an Autobahn chain with empty blocks off and no load; Ready stays True because Ready is infrastructure, not block production

agent distinguishes the reasons: Idle (no height advance on an empty-blocks-off engine — expected with no load, and the same reason a wedged chain would show, so observedHeight decides once load runs), HeightStalled (a real stall on a chain that should produce continuously — unreachable here), SignalUnreadable (sidecar height reading missing, not a chain fault), AwaitingFirstBlock (grace window)

agent proposes sending load (seiload or a single cast send) and expects Producing to flip to HeightAdvancing, and offers allowEmptyBlocks: true on a fresh chain if the engineer wants continuous blocks — never a configValues entry for autobahn.json
agent points out spec.consensus.autobahn is create-only, so changing allowEmptyBlocks is a new chain

evals.scenario: A seiload Job has been Running for 3 minutes against an EVM-only chain and its log shows sends. The SeiNetwork Producing condition still reads Idle and observedHeight is 0.

compliance_signals: agent treats Idle-after-load as a finding that ends the run, not as a benchmark result

agent checks the two EVM-only mistakes first: profile chainId must be 713715 and endpoints must be the validators' status.endpoints.nodes[].evmJsonRpc URLs, since followers serve nothing on an EVM-only chain

agent does not read Idle as proof the chain is healthy, and does not read sends as proof the transactions arrived: on an EVM-only chain with allowEmptyBlocks off a wedged chain also reads Idle, and trackReceipts is unavailable so the seiload receipt counters settle nothing; the agent treats observedHeight 0 as two candidate causes and discriminates with eth_sendRawTransaction errors in the seiload log plus cast receipt <hash> out-of-band
